final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, 1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), differences AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM shares) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_above_average FROM differences ORDER BY share_above_average IS NULL, share_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
